documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Submission Of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On 03Rd November, 2026

analysis.summary: J.G. Chemicals Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, delivering its best-ever quarterly revenue of INR 3,610 million and EBITDA of INR 387 million. Management highlighted robust end-user demand, particularly from the automotive and tyre sectors, along with double-digit volume growth and capacity utilization exceeding 80%. Ongoing expansion projects at Dahej and Naidupeta are progressing as planned to support future growth and product diversification into non-rubber applications. Furthermore, the company maintained an LME-linked pricing model that neutralizes absolute zinc price risks.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margins to reach approximately 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

guidance.claim: For the next financial year, management targets a 50% to 60% utilization rate for the Dahej facility.
guidance.quote: So, we should, we would still be targeting close to 60%, but for conservatism, let us put it at between 50% and 60%.

guidance.claim: Management estimates that the Dahej plant will achieve a utilization of 50% to 60% minimum in FY28 and reach the 70s range the following year.
guidance.quote: So, I just mentioned in the previous question that in FY28, we expect a utilization of 50% to 60% minimum, and the following year, we expect to be in the in the 70s range, and by then we would start the expansion of Phase 2.

guidance.claim: Management expects to continue the strong performance momentum going forward.
guidance.quote: The current quarter is also witnessing strong performance and we expect to continue the strong momentum going forward

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately INR 25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

demand_outlook.claim: Shorter customer approval cycles in ceramics enable faster market penetration.
demand_outlook.quote: Shorter customer approval cycles in ceramics—typically 1–3 months—enable faster market penetration, broadening JGC’s customer base and reducing dependence on individual end-user industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26 and has continued into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: ATMA data showed Q1 FY27 volume growth across vehicle categories with passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture continue to show encouraging traction.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth across categories was in double digits for the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: And the volume growth was in double digits for the current quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong demand from OEMs coupled with strong replacement demand will aid future growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from the OEM’s coupled with strong replacement demand will aid future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project is nearing completion with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project, comprising approximately 15,000 MTPA of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000+ MTPA facility, is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Our material subsidiary i.e. BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd has acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, in 2026, to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.

capex_expansion.claim: With the addition of the Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum, a scale that would position us amongst the top three zinc chemical producers globally.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield facility involves an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of zinc oxide production at Dahej is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is progressing well, and management expects to commission it in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej project will add 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum with a revenue potential in the range of INR300 crores to INR400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, as I just mentioned in the previous question, would be in the range of 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum, and the revenue potential would be in the range of INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and the EBITDA margins that we expect to generate from that project would be in the 11% to 12% range.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capacity being added through the Naidupeta debottlenecking is about 5,000 tons.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the total capacity being added is about 5,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

margins_costs.claim: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: The pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements to help mitigate raw material price risk.
margins_costs.quote: The Company’s pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74%, improving 92 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 %, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 was INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: For Q1 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA for the current quarter was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% as compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management states that the company is neutral to zinc prices.
margins_costs.quote: We are neutral to zinc prices, if you ask me honestly.

margins_costs.claim: The share of non-rubber application revenue in Q1 FY27 was close to 18%.
margins_costs.quote: This quarter, the share of non-rubber would be close to 18% or so.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeded 80% with further improvement expected.
orders_capacity.quote: JGC continued to deliver double-digit volume growth, with zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeding 80% and further improvement expected.

orders_capacity.claim: Upcoming additions at Dahej and Naidupeta will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Together, these additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing is anchored at facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh with an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization levels are in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

capital_allocation.claim: The payback period target for the Dahej plant and other contemplated capex plans is in the range of 3 to 4 years.
capital_allocation.quote: Usually in our company, we always look at a payback period of 3 to 4 years, and I think in our past, in the past, we have always been able to achieve that. So, going forward, our target for the Dahej plant as well as other capex plans that are currently being contemplated is in the range of 3 to 4 years, mostly.

capital_allocation.claim: Expected ROCE from the Dahej project is in the mid-20s (20%-25% annually).
capital_allocation.quote: So, ROCE would be in the mid-20s. So, basically if you want a payback in 4 years, So, you have to generate a return of 20%-25% annually; only then will you get the payback in four years.

risks_headwinds.claim: West Asia disruptions were noted during the period.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility persisted in global supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite continued volatility in global supply chains, JGC’s goodwill, long-standing supplier relationships, scale and financial strength ensured uninterrupted zinc raw material supply, supporting sales growth and reinforcing customer confidence.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflict impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

management_commitments.claim: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.

management_commitments.claim: Operations for pharmaceutical grade zinc oxide at the Gujarat plant are to commence in 12–15 months.
Management aims to reach an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
management_commitments.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets commissioning of the Dahej plant in November.
management_commitments.quote: I would say, it will be sometime in November would be a good estimate.

management_commitments.claim: For the next financial year, the company targets a utilization of 50% to 60% for the Dahej facility.
management_commitments.quote: So, we should, we would still be targeting close to 60%, but for conservatism, let us put it at between 50% and 60%.

management_commitments.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility and Naidupeta brownfield are expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27
